WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT email_key
  FROM lead_processing_state
  WHERE email_key = $1
    AND state IN ('pending','retryable')
    AND stage IN ('ollama','hubspot')
    AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now())
    AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now())
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE lead_processing_state l
SET lease_until = now() + interval '5 minutes', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = now()
FROM candidate
WHERE l.email_key = candidate.email_key
RETURNING l.email_key, l.raw_payload, l.operational_priority;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE lead_processing_state
  SET state = CASE WHEN $2='accepted' THEN 'pending' ELSE $2 END,
      stage = CASE WHEN $2='accepted' THEN 'whatsapp' ELSE 'hubspot' END,
      hubspot_status = $2,
      hubspot_contact_id = NULLIF($3,'__none__'),
      failure_class = NULLIF($4,'__none__'),
      failure_code = CASE WHEN $2='accepted' THEN NULL ELSE $2 END,
      failure_message = NULLIF(convert_from(decode($5,'base64'),'UTF8'),'_'),
      next_retry_at = CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN now()+interval '5 minutes' ELSE NULL END,
      lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now()
  WHERE email_key = $1
  RETURNING email_key
), outbox AS (
  INSERT INTO whatsapp_delivery_state(email_key,status,next_retry_at)
  SELECT email_key,'pending',now() FROM updated WHERE $2='accepted'
  ON CONFLICT(email_key) DO NOTHING
)
SELECT email_key FROM updated WHERE $2='accepted';

UPDATE lead_processing_state SET state=CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN 'retryable' ELSE 'manual_review' END,stage='ollama',ollama_status=$2,failure_class=CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN 'transient' ELSE 'manual_review' END,failure_code=$2,failure_message=NULLIF(convert_from(decode($3,'base64'),'UTF8'),'_'),next_retry_at=CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN now()+interval '5 minutes' ELSE NULL END,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE email_key=$1;
